title: SAML 2.0 interactive onboarding: metadata diff preview & resilience tests
creator: Priya Shah
description: Build an interactive SAML 2.0 onboarding flow that shows operators a live 'metadata diff' preview between the IdP-provided XML and Redwood's expected config, and runs automated resilience checks (certificate rotation, clock skew replay, and truncated metadata) in a dry-run mode. The goal is to reduce manual steps in enterprise SSO setup, decrease connector onboarding time, and lower first-call support volume for SSO misconfigurations.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Wizard uploads or fetches IdP metadata and renders a line-level diff highlighting required fields (entityID, ACS, SingleSignOnService bindings, certificates). 2) Dry-run validator runs a suite of resilience checks and surfaces actionable remediation steps (e.g., cert expired, missing ACS index). 3) Operator can accept the diff, apply a sanitized config, or export a remediation checklist. 4) All interactions are logged to audit stream with connector-level correlation IDs. 5) End-to-end integration tested against three IdP samples (Okta SAML, ADFS, and Shibboleth) and test harness shows <5% false positives on canonical errors.
steps: Implement metadata fetch + cached preflight (with timeout + circuit breaker)
Build XML-to-structured model translator and line-diff preview UI schema
Add resilience test runner (cert rotation, clock skew simulation, missing-assertion, binding mismatch)
Wire dry-run mode to audit log pipeline with correlation_id and operator action events
Create remediation suggestions + quick-fix patches where safe (normalize entityID, pick ACS with https binding)
End-to-end tests against IdP samples and create CI job in security/integration suite
notes: 2026-03-06: Kickoff - scoped MVP to UI diff + 4 resilience tests. PM (Riley) prioritized reducing first-call support by 30%.
2026-03-08: Design review - Samira (Design) suggested inline tooltips for cryptic XML fields; agreed to include 'why this matters' copy for admins.

2026-03-09: Spike complete - implemented parser using existing SAML library with a normalization layer to collapse equivalent URI variants. Found 3 common real-world deviations (ACS index omitted, duplicate cert blocks, HTTP vs HTTPS bindings).
2026-03-10: Security review kickoff - need to ensure metadata uploads are scanned and ephemeral copies are encrypted at rest. Added security_review_required flag and created SR ticket SEC-1121.

2026-03-11: Engineering note - opted for dry-run execution path that does not persist secrets; only stores hashed cert fingerprints in logs. Need small change in audit schema to include cert_fingerprint field.
2026-03-12: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/compare/feature/saml-diff-preview (ENG-47200). Requesting reviews from @marie and @ken.

QA: created test matrix and included three real IdP exports. QA found an edge case with ADFS when multiple SingleLogoutService endpoints exist — added a rule to present operator with selection rather than auto-pick.
test_plan: Automated CI job that runs the dry-run validator against canonical IdP samples on every PR plus a weekly integration job hitting a local test IdP that rotates certs to validate resilience checks. Manual QA checklist for customer-facing messaging and remediation flows.
rollout_plan: Feature gated behind 'sso.onboarding.v2' - start with internal beta (3 customer success accounts), monitor audit stream and support tickets for 2 weeks, then progressive rollout to GA with opt-out for Dedicated/Private until on-prem packaging is validated.
